description: Find an existing heart-shaped running route in a given city. Returns up to 5 AI-validated routes matching the city (and optionally a target distance). Use this when a user mentions a city and wants a heart route — e.g. "find me a heart-shaped route in Paris" or "I want to run a heart in Tokyo for my mum's birthday".

max_distance_km.description: Optional max route length in kilometres. Filter to routes ≤ this distance. Common: 5, 10, 15, 21 (half-marathon).

prefer_gold.description: If true, return only the highest AI-quality "gold" tier routes (ai_score >= 80). Default true.

name: find_heart_route_in_city
